model_output.verdict: A senior payments engineer whose resume connects technical decisions to measurable results.
write_up: This is a strong resume! Your work at Tidewater Commerce and Northwind Billing tells a consistent story: you build payment and billing systems, lead engineers, and improve how those systems run. A recruiter can see both the technical work and why it mattered.

The ledger line is a great model: it names what you built and shows reconciliation breaks falling from about 300 a month to under 10. Your experience comes before education, and the senior headline is backed up by the migration, audit leadership, and mentoring.
You can send this as it is. Your resume is unlikely to be the reason you don't get a callback, though competition for senior payments roles will still matter.
